ModMetaData.name: Unique Melee Weapons
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description: Odyssey's unique weapons are all guns. This mod adds up to 10 unique melee weapons: knife, gladius, longsword, spear, mace and breach axe, plus axe and warhammer with Royalty and two warcasket weapons with VFE Pirates. Each rolls its own stuff, texture, colours, name and up to 3 random traits from a pool of up to 28 balanced for melee. Includes a Savage Warband quest for acquisition, parallel to Odyssey's Ancient Mercenaries. Requires Odyssey.
